Function reference

App and guides

run_app()
Start the casimir app
casimir_guide()
Copy, and optionally render, a casimir guide
casimir_tip()
Short explanations of settings

Island (fishery)

island_x()
Island X: the default training fishery
cas_fishery()
Simulate the fishery (the population of landings)
cas_truth()
True landings by species and stratum

Frame and design

frame_survey()
Frame survey
cas_design()
Survey design
deck_design()
Design of the training deck
design_cost()
Design cost
plot_design_grid()
Week x site grid of a stratum (deck slide 6)

Roll and raise

draw_sample()
Draw a survey sample (Roll)
artefacts()
Planted artefacts
planted_artefacts()
Table of planted artefacts (answer key)
estimate_catch()
Raise a sample to catch per species (Raise)
check_estimate()
Compare an estimate with the truth
plot_estimate()
Estimates against the truth

Spin

replicate_design()
Repeat a design many times (Spin x1000)
compare_designs()
Compare designs on the same fishery
days_vs_boats()
Days or boats? Designs of about equal cost
plot_eval()
Bias, CV and coverage by species

Series, effort and segments

run_survey()
Run a sampling programme over several years
catch_by()
Catch by species and segment (or other groups)
plot_series()
Catch series against the truth
plot_catch_by()
Estimated against true catch, blocked by segment or stratum
effort_by()
Effort by segment (or other groups)
plot_effort_series()
Effort series against the truth
cas_effort_truth()
True effort (number of landings) by stratum

Spin over the years

spin_series()
Spin a sampling programme many times (Spin x1000 over the years)
summary_spins()
Summary of a spun programme by year
plot_spin_series()
Spun programme against the truth, year by year
spins_long()
Estimates against the truth as one long table

Maps

plot_species_map() plot_effort_map() plot_catch_map()
Maps of the island: species, effort and catch

More plots

plot_funnel()
How much of the fishery the sample saw
plot_sample_map()
Where the sampled boats fished
plot_spin()
The spin: distribution of the estimates around the truth

Cash out and utilities

export_survey()
Export a survey (Cash out)
seed_for()
Seed for one stream of random numbers
